ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both primary lobes; narrow, low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge; dark focal point (single spot) on the lower mid-section of the right lobe; high-density dark mottling/blotchiness at the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped indentation with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees; depth occupies roughly 1/10th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; irregular peaks and valleys (3-7 pixel depth) along the entire trailing edge length, from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp upward/convex sweep at the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark, irregular clusters on the leading and trailing edges of both distal tips, consistent with localized surface scarring or prior epibiont attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical low-intensity linear streaks visible on the central-lower portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged, irregular pixel boundaries at the far-left and far-right tips suggests physical trauma or erosion; single isolated dark spot on the lower interior right lobe.
